meta_title: RMP Plumbing & Heating | Local Plumber Leicester
meta_description: RMP Plumbing and Heating offer reliable plumbing and heating services across Leicester. Fast response, free quotes, and quality workmanship guaranteed. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Leicester Plumber — Free Quotes, Fast Response
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or heating problems — RMP respond quickly so your home stays warm and dry.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and boiler servicing to full bathroom installations, RMP cover every plumbing and heating need in and around Leicester.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with our expert repair and annual servicing. We work on all major brands and can often resolve faults on the same visit.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installations, upgrades, and power flushing to restore circulation and heat output. We ensure your system runs at peak efficiency, saving you money on energy bills.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or loss of hot water — we provide a fast emergency response across Leicester to minimise damage and get your home back to normal quickly.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From full bathroom refits to replacing individual fixtures, we handle all aspects of the installation with clean, precise workmanship and minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Persistent drips or hidden leaks can cause costly damage over time. We locate the source quickly and carry out lasting repairs to protect your property.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Whether you need a new radiator fitted, an existing one balanced, or a faulty valve replaced, our team provides a tidy, reliable service with minimal fuss.

about_pullquote: Every job done right — because your home deserves nothing less.
about_para_1: RMP Plumbing and Heating is a locally based plumbing and heating business serving Leicester and the surrounding communities from our base in Countesthorpe. Built on a straightforward commitment to quality workmanship and honest pricing, we've grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendations from satisfied customers across the region.
about_para_2: We believe in turning up on time, explaining the work clearly, and leaving your home as tidy as we found it. Our customers return to us time and again because they know they'll receive a fair quote, skilled workmanship, and no hidden surprises on the final bill.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About RMP

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Called RMP about a leaking pipe on a Friday afternoon and they were with me within a couple of hours. Professional, tidy, and very fairly priced. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and a new radiator fitted in the same visit. Really efficient and knowledgeable — explained everything clearly and left the place spotless. Great local company.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: RMP replaced our old bathroom suite and the result is fantastic. Turned up exactly when they said, worked cleanly throughout, and the finish is excellent. Very happy and will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Mark H.
